```python
from jira import JIRA

jira = JIRA(server='https://your-jira-url.com', basic_auth=('username', 'password'))
```

Replace `'https://your-jira-url.com'` with the URL of your Jira instance and `'username'` and `'password'` with your actual Jira credentials.

```python

can_create_ticket = board.can_create()
print(f"Can create ticket on board {board_id}? {can_create_ticket}")
```

Replace `'123'` with the actual board ID you want to check.

4. Running the above code will print whether you have permissions to create a ticket on the specified board or not.

Note: Ensure that you have the necessary permissions to access the Jira API and retrieve board information. Additionally, make sure you have installed the required libraries (`jira`) for making API requests to Jira.
